facts.fact: The Lesotho Tribune reports the Central Bank of Lesotho, with Fintech, introduced LESWITCH, a national platform enabling transactions between mobile money wallets.

LSO.note: Document does not mention consumer protection.
Document states no cross-border corridor or regional link.
Document does not mention government payments to people.
Document gives no survey account-ownership figure.

facts.fact: The Lesotho Tribune reports LESWITCH enables transactions between mobile money accounts including Mpesa, Ecocash, My Wallet, C-Pay and Khetsi, letting users send money to other wallets.

LSO.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
